global_aesthetic: Edgy urban street-food vibe. Think Brooklyn smash-burger joint. High contrast, aggressive, tactile. No generic SaaS look. Use gritty textures, halftone dots, tape strips, and stencil/graffiti aesthetics. Sanitized fast-food chains are the enemy.

rules.H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-['Anton'] uppercase tracking-tight leading-none text-[#F5F1E8]
rules.H2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-['Anton'] uppercase tracking-tight text-[#F5F1E8]
rules.H3: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-['Bebas_Neue'] uppercase tracking-wider text-[#EF2B2D]
rules.labels: text-sm md:text-base font-['Bebas_Neue'] uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[#A1A1A1]

typography.instruction: Headings must never use Inter or Space Grotesk. Headings must be uppercase. Use 'Permanent Marker' sparingly for hand-scrawled annotations like arrows or 'Sold Out' tags.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise grain overlay over the entire application. Backgrounds should feel tactile. Use greaseproof paper textures or halftone dot patterns for section dividers.
visual_enhancers.borders: Neo-brutalist approach. Use thick 2px-4px solid borders (`border-2 border-[#262626]`) instead of soft shadows. For active states, border turns `#EF2B2D`.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use `rounded-none` or max `rounded-sm` for a sharp, aggressive look. No soft, friendly pill shapes unless it's a specific status badge.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard offset shadows (e.g., `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#EF2B2D]`). Never use soft, diffuse ambient shadows.

layouts.marketing_pages: Asymmetric Bento Grids. Overlapping elements. Large full-bleed hero image of a grilled burger with heavy black gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-[#0A0A0A]/60 to-transparent`) to ensure text readability.
layouts.menu_grid: Grid columns: 1 on mobile, 2 on tablet, 3 on desktop. Tight gap (`gap-4` or `gap-6`). Direct grid children must align at the top but stretch to fill height.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Utilitarian Brutalism. Sidebar on the left (Charcoal #141414), main content on right (#0A0A0A). Metric cards with sharp corners and red accents. Strict hierarchy, dense spacing.
layouts.spacing: Generous paddings around major sections (`py-20 md:py-32`). Internal card paddings should be tight and dense (`p-4` or `p-6`).

motion.hover_states: Snappy and aggressive. `hover:scale-[1.02]` on cards. Use `hover:-translate-y-1`.
motion.reveals: Staggered fade-up for menu items. Use `framer-motion`.

accessibility.contrast: Red (#EF2B2D) against Black (#0A0A0A) passes APCA contrast. Ensure off-white text is used over dark backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing/hero sections, do not rely on generic Shadcn cards.
Customize Shadcn components (Dialog, Tabs, Forms) to strip their Vercel-look and replace with hard edges (rounded-none), thick borders, and red/black active states.
Load 'Anton', 'Bebas Neue', and 'Outfit' fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
Use framer-motion for staggering menu items and modal slide-ups.
Implement the FR/EN toggle in the header.
Ensure 'Burger Times' graffiti logo reference is used or approximated heavily using typography if raw image is unsuitable.
For the burger builder, use state management effectively for the multi-step flow.
Add global grain texture using a fixed pseudo-element with CSS noise overlay or a semi-transparent repeating background image.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and offset hard shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles, but for this specific app, use sharp edges (rounded-none) matching the brutalist theme.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns. Use solid #0A0A0A or #141414.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Ensure ALL interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
